tools.name: pricing_info
tools.description: Free — list every paid tool in the 'us-brand-intelligence' bundle with its price, payTo address and network. Call this first if you don't have a wallet ready yet.

tools.name: us-brand-action-queue
tools.description: Turn verified US brand signals into one deterministic prioritized action queue with evidence, urgency, ownership status, and rule traces for downstream operators and agents. The Actor does not send messages or write to destinations. — $0.05/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: us-brand-evidence-chronology-builder
tools.description: Build a deterministic chronology from 1 to 30 closed US brand evidence rows and an explicit UTC as-of time. It sorts supplied facts, marks same-time groups, reports future-dated IDs, and emits stable counts and digests. — $0.05/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: us-brand-evidence-citation-table
tools.description: Turn a small buyer-owned evidence packet into a stable citation table with bounded Markdown citations, host and source counts, limitations, and digests. It formats the supplied facts and does not browse, fetch, verify, rank, or enrich them. — $0.05/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: us-brand-evidence-snapshot-diff
tools.description: Compare two small buyer-supplied US brand evidence snapshots and return a stable machine-readable report of added, removed, changed, and unchanged records. Inline-only, deterministic, and designed for agents that already own both snapshots. — $0.05/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: us-brand-federal-award-snapshot
tools.description: Given one exact USAspending recipient ID and a bounded UTC date window, return a deterministic snapshot of federal contract transactions for that recipient. Built for company and government-intelligence agents; no buyer URL, API key, browser, or LLM. — $0.05/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: us-brand-offer-evidence-normalizer
tools.description: Turn supplied US brand offer, coupon, ad, and landing-page evidence into closed deterministic JSON. Submit bounded inline rows or one authorized read-only Dataset; the Actor validates source proof and terms without browsing or inferring ownership. — $0.05/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: us-brand-signal-batch-splitter
tools.description: Split a bounded batch of normalized US brand signal rows by brand, event type, severity, or analysis status. Receive stable groups, exact IDs, counts, and SHA-256 digests without browsing, enrichment, inference, or child calls. — $0.05/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: us-brand-signal-brand-summary
tools.description: Summarize 1 to 60 buyer-supplied normalized US brand signals for up to 15 explicit brands. Receive deterministic counts and grouped facts without identity resolution, source verification, browsing, or live enrichment. — $0.05/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: us-brand-signal-brief-composer
tools.description: Turn a buyer-supplied snapshot of US brand signals into one bounded deterministic machine-readable brief. It reduces the facts you provide and does not discover, fetch, verify, or enrich evidence. — $0.05/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: us-brand-signal-confidence-gate
tools.description: Classify buyer-supplied normalized US brand signal scores against explicit accept and review thresholds. Receive sorted accepted, review, and rejected IDs with stable reason codes, counts, and digests; no source or identity claims are made. — $0.05/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: us-brand-signal-cooccurrence-analyzer
tools.description: Measure how often buyer-supplied opaque signal IDs appear together in bounded observation groups. Return stable signal counts, unordered pair counts, support, Jaccard overlap, and digests without fetching or making causality claims. — $0.05/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: us-brand-signal-crm-field-mapper
tools.description: Turn 1 to 100 buyer-supplied US brand signal rows into unsent HubSpot, Salesforce, or generic CRM field proposals while preserving evidence IDs and URLs. No CRM credentials, network calls, proxy, LLM, identity resolution, or arbitrary expressions. — $0.05/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: us-brand-signal-cross-tabulator
tools.description: Build a deterministic two-dimensional count table from buyer-supplied opaque rows, such as event type by status or brand by review state. It only counts the bounded request and does not verify sources or infer causality. — $0.05/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: us-brand-signal-merge-report
tools.description: Reconcile two buyer-supplied batches of normalized US brand signals. Receive a deterministic union, exact duplicate IDs, field conflicts, one-sided ID sets, counts, and digests without choosing a winner or making a truth claim. — $0.05/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: us-brand-signal-metrics-aggregator
tools.description: Compute deterministic machine-friendly metrics for US brand signal rows you already collected, including event, severity, status, source, confidence, warning, and digest metrics. Stateless, keyless, offline, and bounded for agent pipelines. — $0.05/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: us-brand-signal-policy-simulator
tools.description: Compare buyer-defined threshold policies over the same opaque US brand signal scores. Return accepted, review, and rejected IDs for every policy plus differences and sensitivity summaries; it does not choose or recommend a policy. — $0.05/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: us-brand-signal-rule-router
tools.description: Turn normalized US brand signals and ordered rules into a deterministic routing plan with matched routes, unmatched IDs, counts, warnings, and reproducible digests. It never sends messages, calls destinations, fetches URLs, or infers identity. — $0.05/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: us-brand-signal-sequence-transition-analyzer
tools.description: Measure ordered adjacent transitions in buyer-supplied opaque sequences for workflow, funnel, and journey analysis. The bounded processor analyzes only the JSON you provide and makes no identity or causality claim. — $0.05/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: us-brand-signal-sla-checker
tools.description: Classify buyer-supplied schedule rows against an explicit UTC timestamp: which items met their due time, missed it, or remain open. Deterministic and offline; it never fetches a clock or resolves an item to a person or company. — $0.05/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: us-brand-signal-webhook-payload-builder
tools.description: Build one bounded deterministic unsent payload shaped for Slack, Teams, or a generic webhook from one normalized signal and buyer-supplied evidence. The Actor never sends a webhook or accepts a destination. — $0.05/call, x402 (USDC on base).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "us-brand-signal-crm-field-mapper" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Turn 1 to 100 buyer-supplied US brand signal rows into unsent HubSpot, Salesforce, or generic CRM field proposals while preserving evidence IDs and URLs. No CRM…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "us-brand-intelligence" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: us-brand-signal-confidence-gate · Private data: pricing_info, us-brand-evidence-snapshot-diff, us-brand-federal-award-snapshot, us-brand-signal-crm-field-mapper · Public sink: us-brand-action-queue, us-brand-offer-evidence-normalizer, us-brand-signal-webhook-payload-builder.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: us-brand-signal-confidence-gate · Private data: pricing_info, us-brand-evidence-snapshot-diff, us-brand-federal-award-snapshot, us-brand-signal-crm-field-mapper · Public sink: us-brand-action-queue, us-brand-offer-evidence-normalizer, us-brand-signal-webhook-payload-builder

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
